arms.A: baseline: synthetic trajectories, existing invention, no PSI, no repair, floor 0
arms.AF: A + the existing per-round synthesis CPU floor MIN_SYNTH_CPU 10 s (control: CPU reallocation, not representation)
arms.AR: A + the existing in-place counterexample repair (control: separates repair from the latent)
arms.P: A + PSI (PSI_QUERIES 10, PSI_K 2, PSI_SYNTH_SHARE 0.6, PSI_CPU_FRAC 1.0, description-length/posterior ranking) + in-place repair
arms.PDq: V2 control: P's SOURCE queries replayed and solved passively (Dq), no formation
arms.Pl: P with the learned discovery policy (policy.json weights, fitted on training tasks only)
arms.Pno: P with the discovered latent withheld (same distinction experiments and invention; necessity control)

criteria.INVENTION_EVIDENCE (per task): P robustly verifies it with an accepted machine that contains a PSI latent, and none of A, AR, AF, Pno robustly verifies it
criteria.REGRESSION: tasks A robustly verifies and P does not (reported, never excluded)
criteria.V1 rule (frozen V1 criterion, as develop: P vs A: net >= 10 verified, exact two-sided McNemar p < 0.05, P-only tasks from >= 2 structure classes (list-routines compositions, FST)
criteria.V2 rule (frozen V2 criterion, P in D's p: >= 5 tasks solved by P with an accepted machine of m >= 2 components that PDq does not solve
criteria.V3 rule (frozen V3 criterion, Pl in E's: Pl-only >= 5 and p < 0.05, or solved(Pl) >= solved(P) with total CPU(Pl) <= 0.7 x CPU(P)
criteria.official: the sealed V1 PASS, V2 OPEN (independent), V3 FAIL and Q3 OPEN are not changed by this development evaluation; generalization beyond these two developer-chosen families stays OPEN
criteria.robust: an arm robustly verifies a task when it verifies it in a strict majority of its runs (base run alone if the task was not replicated)
criteria.verified_solve: hidden test passed AND every random diagnostic SOURCE input correct (300 inputs, seed 777)

harness: research/q3/budgeted_reach_dev.py (run_arm('D'); Env(spec, 0, budget=60); seed sha256(name) % 1000; fresh process per (arm, task, seed); --semantic; --workers 4; PYTHONHASHSEED=0)
no_post_hoc: PSI constants, policy weights, arms, task lists, seeds and criteria are not changed after this commit; a change after seeing evaluation results turns the set into development data
not_counted: the 18 PSI development tasks, the 60 section-36 transfer tasks, every section 35-38 task

policy.training_tasks: the 18 PSI development tasks and the 60 section-36 transfer tasks (all already used); no evaluation task

runs.PDq: every task P solves (hidden test) in its base run, replaying that run
runs.replication: every task whose verified outcome differs between any two arms run on it: 2 more same-seed runs and seeds 1, 2 (sha256(name) + 7919 k), for every arm run on that task

status: FROZEN before any agent run on the evaluation set (development only; official sealed verdicts unchanged)
